👋 Welcome to *Ting-A-Ling Schools*!

I'm here to help with common enquiries. Just ask me about:

• 💰 Fees & payments
• ⏰ School hours
• 👔 Uniforms
• 📋 Absentee reporting
• 📅 Events & calendar
• 📍 Contact details
• 📝 Enrolment

If you need something else, a human will be with you shortly!

🏫 *Ting-A-Ling Schools - Fee Enquiry*

For current fee structures and payment options, please contact our admin office during school hours (07:30 - 15:30 weekdays).

📞 035 XXX XXXX
✉️ admin@tingaling.co.za

Alternatively, tell us which class/grade your child is in and we'll have the relevant information sent to you.
Thank for the hard work, sleep well
